hookText: Four Claude Code hooks that fail closed

beats.say: The author writes four hooks for every Android app: they block risky edits, wipe commands, and finishing while TypeScript still fails.
A hook is code that runs every time and the agent cannot argue with it, unlike a rule in a markdown file it can forget.
Hooks answer with an exit code: exit code two blocks the call, and anything else lets it go ahead by default.
